name: vulngraph
description: Real-time ENTRY/SINK/GUARD detection with local analysis

vulngraph.projectPath.description: Optional path visible to the backend for scanning. Use a container path such as /app/demo_project when the backend runs in Docker; leave empty when it runs locally.

enumDescriptions: Scan by path and upload the project only when the backend cannot access that path. Best choice for local or Docker backends.
Always scan by path. The backend must be able to access the selected folder.
Always upload Python and Java files before scanning. Useful when the backend runs in Docker.
vulngraph.scanMode.description: How the selected project is sent to the backend.
